description.value: Mark Twain, also known as Samuel Langhorne Clemen, was an American writer, humorist, entrepreneur, and publisher considered to be the greatest humorist of the United States as well as the father of American literature. His most famous works include The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, and The Great American Novel.
